Name: Lance's Children
Author: StardewStardude
Description:
A portrait for two children with Lance and the Farmer from SDVE. Designed to be placed in the Lance folder that SDVE and Little NPCs with this mod instead of Child to NPC. It works the same.

  It can be used with Unique Children and Unique Children Talk.

Please put the big portraits of the boy and girl in the folder for the Unique Children Talk if you are using that.

It will work as long as you have SDVE, Little NPCs and Unique Children updated to the latest patch/unofficial update.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a sprite recolour, so it doesn't need a Manifest JSON file.  It goes in the Farmer's Kids file under Lance, which should be empty. I am told Vortex hates this, because it doesn't contain a .JSON file, but that's because the mods it works with have them.

Downloads.Description: two portraits for Lance's Son and Daughter, with the farmer. Made using Clip Studio Paint, and a drawing tablet. Now with Baby sprites and children sprites, with thanks to ErosDKAI and Xiddav for making the files available to customise!
